description: Configure the built-in form-to-email relay, fully self-service. Supports a custom From (via a verified sender domain or your own SMTP relay), an explicit Reply-To, and full email branding (subject template, field labels/order, logo, accent color, or a custom HTML body). Requires team role owner or admin. Pass config:null to switch the relay off. If you set a custom `sender` without an `smtpRelay`, the response returns the DNS records to publish; then call verify_forms_sender_domain. Submissions: POST JSON to the returned `endpoint` with Content-Type: application/json (UTF-8). Flat object of form fields (strings/numbers/booleans; checkbox groups may be arrays of strings, joined with ', '). Max 30 fields, 5000 chars/field, 20000 total. Response: {success:true,data:{ok:true}} or {success:false,error:{code,message}}. Rate limit: 10 submits per IP per 10 minutes. Include a hidden honeypot input (default "_gotcha") and leave it empty.

allowedOrigins.description: Extra origins allowed to POST. The site's own domains are always allowed.

confirmation.description: Optional confirmation email to the visitor.

emailField.description: Form field with the visitor email. Default "email".

enabled.description: Master switch. false keeps the config but the endpoint returns 404.

honeypotField.description: Hidden field that must stay empty. Default "_gotcha".

replyTo.description: Reply-To: "visitor" (default), "none", a fixed email, or { field: "<formField>" }.

email.description: From address, e.g. support@serso.be. Only honored once its domain is verified (verify_forms_sender_domain) OR an smtpRelay is set; otherwise mail falls back to the platform address.

smtpRelay.description: Deliver via your own SMTP server instead of the platform. Your server then owns SPF/DKIM. Recipients stay server-side — this is not an open relay.

allowInvalidCert.description: Accept a self-signed/mismatched cert (starttls|tls). Default false.

host.description: SMTP server hostname or IP (must be public).

password.description: Set to store/replace (encrypted at rest). Omit to keep the existing one. null to clear. Never returned on read.

username.description: Omit for a no-auth trusted-host relay.

bodyHtml.description: Full custom HTML body with {fieldName} placeholders (values HTML-escaped). Overrides the generated table.

fieldLabels.description: Map raw field name -> human label.

fieldOrder.description: Display order; unlisted fields follow in submit order.

logoUrl.description: https logo URL shown in the email header.

config.description: Full config to store (replaces existing). Pass null to disable and clear.

name: set_forms_config

activeSender.description: The From that will actually be used right now.

endpoint.description: URL the site's form should POST to.

senderDomain.description: DNS records to publish + verification status (verified-domain path).

title: Enable or update the forms relay for a site
